title: indigo_test: fix the intermittent failure of the scheduler test edit_of_running_task_is_deferred
description:
The integration case `edit_of_running_task_is_deferred` in indigo_test/integration/test_agent_scheduler.c fails intermittently: about 1 in 6 runs when run alone (observed 2026-11-19 during ticket cc3c31d5; the full suite then passed on rerun). Two independent observations of the likely cause, not yet confirmed:
- the scheduler sends "Task completed" before it applies the pending edit, and the test reads TASK_0 right after that message;
- the task body takes about 2 s and can finish before the edit arrives, so the edit is not applied as a deferred edit.
The failure is not related to DEFER_GAIN (that path is not reached with the default 0).

Work: reproduce with repeated runs (argv filter, not INDIGO_TEST_CASE_FILTER), find the race, and fix the test synchronisation (wait for the state the assertion needs instead of a message that precedes it), or the agent if the order of its updates is actually wrong. Verify with many repeated runs.
